reloadResidentWorkspaceLogical.reason: SW216 admits the parser and actual retained policy/directory independently around the unchanged transactional stamp, journal and installed-source reload. The public reload no longer holds a redundant blanket policy reservation. Exact warm/stale peer reload, occupied 32 MiB budget, large normalization base, predecode policy denial and cancellation preserve the installed source and release work. SW216 plus SW21 personal-scrub regressions pass normally, twice on persistent SQLite and with race; SW27/SW30/SW33 lifecycle regressions also pass. One actual-header MAX query per logical reload bounds driver allocation before reading strings. reloadResidentWorkspace delegates to it with logical=false; logical=true (a default COLD write publishing a key a test view does not hold yet, SW555) builds the installed logical source instead of the policy-only probe reload.
reloadResidentWorkspaceLogical.temperatureReason: Installed source freshness supports HOT requests and tickers.

installResidentPolicySource.reason: Installs a preflighted resident policy and optional immutable logical source together under the store and residency locks after commit; committed writers also publish default workspace selection atomically. SW27/SW30 lifecycle tests cover exact/unknown stamps, late failure, key recreation, cancellation and retained generations.

loadResidentWorkspaces.reason: Original P21 bounded core adapter: explicit record scopes or policy-only residency, process admission, and rejection of unported complete-snapshot operations are covered by the P21 integration tests.
